Will Summary
ClearLegacy fictional demonstration household
FICTIONAL DEMO RECORD - NOT REAL CLIENT DATA
Document ID: JOHNSON-WILL-2019

Testator: Robert James Johnson, of San Diego County, California.

Family: The testator has three children now living, namely Emily Johnson, David Johnson and Sarah Johnson.

Tangible personal property: "I give all of my tangible personal property to my children who survive me, to be divided among them as they shall agree."

Residuary estate: "I give the residue of my estate in equal shares to my children, Emily Johnson, David Johnson and Sarah Johnson."

Brokerage account: "My brokerage account at LPL Financial shall pass as part of my residuary estate."

=== PAGE 2 ===
Executor: "I nominate and appoint my brother, Thomas Johnson, as Executor of this Will. If he fails to qualify or ceases to act, I nominate my daughter, Emily Johnson, as alternate Executor."

Governing law: "This Will shall be construed and administered under the laws of the State of California."

Execution: The summary records that the will was signed on March 14, 2019, at San Diego, California, with two witnesses.

This is a fictional summary for demonstration. It is not a legal document and has not been reviewed by an attorney.
